experience.location: Full-time remote (UK-based startup; based in Lagos, Nigeria)

bullets.text: Architected and deployed Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Databricks services alongside containerized application workloads running on Kubernetes (AKS) pods and nodes with Azure Container Registry (ACR) to power a Growth Intelligence & AI prediction platform achieving a >60% prediction success rate.

Leveraged GitHub Copilot Enterprise across the engineering lifecycle to design and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and reusable Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM/Bicep) spanning compute, storage, containerization, identity (IAM), and security.

Administered and monitored hybrid cloud infrastructure across AWS and Microsoft Azure, executing routine system health checks, capacity monitoring, OS performance tuning, and FinOps cost optimization to sustain high availability.

Configured and secured enterprise network topologies including VPCs, VNets, VPN connectivity, route tables, security groups, NSGs, private endpoints, and Azure Key Vault secrets/certificates for resilient microservices communication.

Engineered AI-assisted observability, logging, and monitoring frameworks supporting business intelligence and ML prediction workloads while enforcing DevSecOps controls, vulnerability checks, patching schedules, and disaster recovery procedures.

Automated technical documentation, architecture diagrams, SOPs, and agile project tracking by engineering AI-driven REST API integrations with ClickUp to dynamically create and update sprint boards and task statuses.
